description.zh-cn: 13 种 Folia 歌词动效铺满播放页，双击歌词切换全屏，鼠标靠近时显示控制栏，支持逐字动效、样式预览与独立开关。
description.zh-tw: 13 種 Folia 歌詞動效鋪滿播放頁，雙擊歌詞切換全螢幕，滑鼠靠近時顯示控制列，支援逐字動效、樣式預覽與獨立開關。
description.en-us: Fill the player with 13 Folia lyric styles, double-click lyrics to toggle fullscreen, and reveal controls as the pointer approaches, with word animations, previews and a separate toggle.
